in the last decade , studies about the structure and dynamics of complex networks have blossomed , thanks in particular to the versatility of the network representation , which has turned out to be adequate for systems as diverse as the internet or social networks . 
 a large body of knowledge about the empirical description of networked systems has thus been accumulated , together with a wealth of modeling techniques ; a good level of understanding of how dynamical processes taking place on networks depend on their structure has been as well reached @xcite . 
 many network studies have been concerned with systems of interest in several scientific areas a priori remote from physics ( social sciences , biology , computer science , epidemiology , ... ) , and they have also reached more traditional fields of statistical physics , such as the study of glassy systems , as we now describe . 
 the many puzzles raised by the glass transition , and in particular the slow dynamics displayed by glassy systems at low temperatures , have been the subject of a large interest in the past decades @xcite . 
 one of the approaches which has led to promising insights consists in the description of the dynamics of a glassy system inside its configuration space . 
 the energy landscape of a glassy system is typically rugged , made of many local minima ( metastable states ) , whose huge number makes it difficult to reach equilibrium . in this framework , 
 the energy landscape is seen as a set of basins of attractions of local minima ( `` traps '' ) , and the system evolves through a succession of harmonic vibrations inside traps and jumps between minima @xcite . 
 this picture has stimulated the definition and study of various simplified models of dynamical evolution between traps , in order to reproduce the phenomenology of glassy dynamics @xcite . 
 on the other hand , several studies have focused on obtaining a better understanding of the structure of these local minima . 
 a way to ...
output:
we present a simple mathematical framework for the description of the dynamics of glassy systems in terms of a random walk in a complex energy landscape pictured as a network of minima . 
 we show how to use the tools developed for the study of dynamical processes on complex networks , in order to go beyond mean - field models that consider that all minima are connected to each other . 
 we consider several possibilities for the transition rates between minima , and show that in all cases the existence of a glassy phase depends on a delicate interplay between the network s topology and the relationship between energy and degree of a minimum . 
 interestingly , the network s degree correlations and the details of the transition rates do not play any role in the existence ( nor in the value ) of the transition temperature , but have an impact only on more involved properties . for glauber or metropolis rates in particular , we find that the low - temperature phase can be further divided into two regions with different scaling properties of the average trapping time . 
 overall , our results rationalize and link the empirical findings about correlations between the energy of the minima and their degree , and should stimulate further investigations on this issue .

instruction: 请将以下英文内容译为中文，保持专业术语准确。
input: Semantic segmentation methods aim to assign a semantic label to every pixel in an image, thereby enabling fine-grained scene understanding. Early approaches relied on hand-crafted features combined with probabilistic graphical models such as Conditional Random Fields (CRFs) to enforce spatial consistency. With the advent of deep learning, fully convolutional networks (FCNs) revolutionized the field by replacing fully connected layers with convolutional layers, allowing end-to-end dense prediction on arbitrary-sized images. Subsequent architectures, including U-Net and SegNet, introduced encoder–decoder structures that leverage skip connections to recover spatial resolution while preserving high-level semantic information. More recent methods, such as DeepLab series, employ atrous (dilated) convolution to enlarge the receptive field without increasing computational cost, along with atrous spatial pyramid pooling (ASPP) to capture multi-scale contextual information. Transformer-based models have further advanced semantic segmentation by modeling long-range dependencies through self-attention mechanisms, effectively overcoming the locality limitations of convolutional operations. Hybrid CNN–Transformer architectures balance local feature extraction and global context modeling, achieving state-of-the-art performance on challenging benchmarks. Additionally, loss functions such as Dice loss and focal loss are often adopted to address class imbalance, while post-processing techniques refine boundary accuracy. Overall, modern semantic segmentation methods integrate architectural innovations, multi-scale context aggregation, and advanced optimization strategies to achieve precise and robust pixel-level predictions.
output: 语义分割方法旨在为图像中的每一个像素分配一个语义标签，从而实现精细化的场景理解。早期方法依赖手工设计的特征，并结合条件随机场（Conditional Random Fields，CRFs）等概率图模型来增强空间一致性。随着深度学习的兴起，全卷积网络（Fully Convolutional Networks，FCNs）通过用卷积层替代全连接层，彻底革新了该领域，使得在任意尺寸图像上进行端到端的密集预测成为可能。随后提出的架构，如 U-Net 和 SegNet，引入了编码器–解码器结构，并利用跳跃连接（skip connections）在保留高层语义信息的同时恢复空间分辨率。较新的方法，如 DeepLab 系列，采用空洞（膨胀）卷积（atrous/dilated convolution）在不增加计算成本的情况下扩大感受野，并结合空洞空间金字塔池化（Atrous Spatial Pyramid Pooling，ASPP）以捕获多尺度上下文信息。基于 Transformer 的模型通过自注意力（self-attention）机制建模长程依赖关系，进一步推动了语义分割的发展，有效克服了卷积操作在局部建模方面的局限性。CNN–Transformer 混合架构在局部特征提取与全局上下文建模之间取得了平衡，在具有挑战性的基准数据集上实现了最先进的性能。此外，Dice loss、focal loss 等损失函数常被用于缓解类别不平衡问题，而后处理技术则用于提升边界预测的精度。总体而言，现代语义分割方法通过融合架构创新、多尺度上下文聚合以及先进的优化策略，实现了精确且鲁棒的像素级预测。

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
Image classification networks aim to automatically assign semantic labels to images, a fundamental problem in computer vision with applications in medical imaging, autonomous driving, remote sensing, and multimedia retrieval. The core challenge lies in bridging the gap between low-level pixel representations and high-level semantic concepts while maintaining robustness to variations in illumination, viewpoint, scale, and noise. Traditional approaches relied on handcrafted features such as SIFT or HOG combined with shallow classifiers, but their limited representation capacity constrained performance on large-scale and complex datasets.

Modern image classification is dominated by deep convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which learn hierarchical feature representations directly from data. A typical CNN architecture consists of stacked convolutional layers for local feature extraction, non-linear activation functions such as ReLU to introduce non-linearity, pooling layers for spatial downsampling, and fully connected layers or global average pooling for classification. Early influential models like AlexNet demonstrated that deep architectures trained on large datasets could significantly outperform traditional methods. Subsequent architectures, including VGG, ResNet, DenseNet, and EfficientNet, explored depth, width, connectivity patterns, and scaling strategies to improve accuracy and computational efficiency.

Residual learning, introduced by ResNet, addresses the degradation problem observed in very deep networks by incorporating identity shortcut connections that facilitate gradient flow during backpropagation. Dense connectivity further encourages feature reuse and alleviates vanishing gradients by connecting each layer to all subsequent layers. More recent image classification networks integrate attention mechanisms, such as squeeze-and-excitation blocks or self-attention modules, to adaptively recalibrate channel-wise or spatial feature responses, improving discriminative power. Vision Transformers (ViTs) represent a paradigm shift by modeling global image context through multi-head self-attention, treating images as sequences of patches rather than relying solely on convolutional inductive biases.

From a training perspective, large-scale labeled datasets like ImageNet, along with data augmentation, regularization techniques, and optimized loss functions (e.g., cross-entropy with label smoothing), are crucial for achieving strong generalization. Transfer learning has become a standard practice, where networks pretrained on large datasets are fine-tuned for downstream tasks with limited labeled data. Evaluation metrics such as top-1 and top-5 accuracy provide standardized benchmarks for comparing models.

In conclusion, image classification networks have evolved from shallow, handcrafted pipelines to highly optimized deep architectures capable of learning rich visual representations end-to-end. Advances in network design, optimization strategies, and training paradigms have led to substantial improvements in accuracy and efficiency. As research continues, the integration of hybrid CNN–Transformer models and more data-efficient learning methods is expected to further enhance performance and applicability across diverse real-world scenarios.

solving matrix eigenvalue problems is crucial in many scientific and engineering applications . 
 robust solvers for problems of moderate size are well developed and widely available  @xcite . 
 these are sometimes referred to as direct solvers  @xcite . 
 direct solvers typically calculate the entire spectrum of the matrix or matrix pencil in question . yet in many applications , especially for those where the underlying linear systems are large and sparse , it is often the case that only selected segments of the spectrum are of interest . 
 polizzi recently proposed a density - matrix - based algorithm  @xcite named feast for hermitian eigenproblems of this kind . from an implementation point of view , feast s main building block is a numerical - quadrature computation , consisting of solving independent linear systems , each for multiple right hand sides . 
 this building block contains multiple levels of parallelism and thus exploits the features of modern computing architectures very well . 
 a software package feast  @xcite based on this approach has been made available since 2009 . 
 nevertheless , theoretical analysis of feast has been lagging its software development . in particular 
 , there is no theoretical study available on the conditions under which feast converges , and if so , at what rate . 
 this paper shows that the feast algorithm can be understood as a standard subspace iteration in conjunction with the rayleigh - ritz procedure . 
 feast therefore belongs to the class of projection methods that typically construct bases to particular subspaces and then obtain the corresponding ritz values and vectors . 
 ( for example , see  @xcite chapter 6 . ) in krylov projection methods such as lanczos  @xcite or arnoldi  @xcite , the subspace at iteration @xmath0 is spanned by a set of the form @xmath1 , where @xmath2 is the matrix in question . 
 the dimensions of the subspaces grow as iterations proceed .

the calculation of a segment of eigenvalues and their corresponding eigenvectors of a hermitian matrix or matrix pencil has many applications . 
 a new density - matrix - based algorithm has been proposed recently and a software package feast has been developed . 
 the density - matrix approach allows feast s implementation to exploit a key strength of modern computer architectures , namely , multiple levels of parallelism . 
 consequently , the software package has been well received , especially in the electronic structure community . 
 nevertheless , theoretical analysis of feast has lagged . 
 for instance , the feast algorithm has not been proven to converge . 
 this paper offers a detailed numerical analysis of feast . 
 in particular , we show that the feast algorithm can be understood as an accelerated subspace iteration algorithm in conjunction with the rayleigh - ritz procedure . 
 the novelty of feast lies in its accelerator which is a rational matrix function that approximates the spectral projector onto the eigenspace in question . 
 analysis of the numerical nature of this approximate spectral projector and the resulting subspaces generated in the feast algorithm establishes the algorithm s convergence . 
 this paper shows that feast is resilient against rounding errors and establishes properties that can be leveraged to enhance the algorithm s robustness . 
 finally , we propose an extension of feast to handle non - hermitian problems and suggest some future research directions .

output: Federated learning is a machine learning paradigm for distributed model training under the premise that data never leave their local domains. By iteratively exchanging model parameters or gradients between multiple clients and a central server, it enables collaborative modeling across data silos. Its core workflow typically adopts optimization algorithms such as FedAvg, performing multiple rounds of local stochastic gradient descent followed by secure aggregation to reduce communication overhead and protect privacy. To address challenges such as non-independent and identically distributed (Non-IID) client data, system heterogeneity, and unstable connectivity, research has introduced personalized modeling, weighted aggregation, and adaptive learning rate strategies. In addition, federated learning is often combined with differential privacy, homomorphic encryption, and secure multi-party computation to provide quantifiable privacy guarantees while ensuring model convergence.

instruction: Translate to Chinese:
input: Vision Transformers (ViTs) represent a paradigm shift in computer vision by replacing convolutional inductive biases with a pure attention-based architecture adapted from natural language processing. In a typical ViT framework, an input image is decomposed into a sequence of fixed-size, non-overlapping patches, each of which is linearly projected into an embedding space and augmented with learnable positional encodings to preserve spatial information. These patch embeddings are then processed by a stack of Transformer encoder layers composed of multi-head self-attention (MHSA) and position-wise feed-forward networks, enabling global context modeling across the entire image. Unlike convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which rely on local receptive fields and hierarchical feature extraction, ViTs capture long-range dependencies inherently through self-attention, leading to superior performance in large-scale vision tasks when sufficient training data is available. However, the quadratic computational complexity of self-attention with respect to the number of patches poses scalability challenges for high-resolution images, motivating numerous architectural optimizations such as hierarchical token representations, sparse attention mechanisms, and hybrid CNN-Transformer models. Empirically, ViTs have demonstrated state-of-the-art results in image classification, object detection, and semantic segmentation, particularly when pre-trained on large datasets and fine-tuned for downstream tasks. Their flexibility and strong representation learning capabilities continue to drive research in efficient attention, data-efficient training, and multimodal vision-language models.
output:
视觉 Transformer（Vision Transformers，ViTs）通过以一种源自自然语言处理的纯基于注意力（attention）的架构取代卷积归纳偏置，在计算机视觉领域引入了范式转变。在典型的 ViT 框架中，输入图像被分解为一系列固定大小、互不重叠的图像块（patch），每个 patch 通过线性映射投影到嵌入空间中，并叠加可学习的位置编码（positional encodings）以保留空间信息。随后，这些 patch 嵌入被送入由多层 Transformer 编码器（encoder）组成的堆叠结构中，编码器包含多头自注意力（multi-head self-attention，MHSA）和逐位置前馈网络（position-wise feed-forward networks），从而实现对整幅图像的全局上下文建模。

与依赖局部感受野和层次化特征提取的卷积神经网络（CNNs）不同，ViTs 通过自注意力机制天然地捕获长程依赖关系，在训练数据充足的情况下，在大规模视觉任务中表现出更优的性能。然而，自注意力机制在计算复杂度上相对于 patch 数量呈二次增长，这在高分辨率图像场景下带来了可扩展性挑战，进而促使研究者提出了多种结构优化方案，例如分层 token 表示、稀疏注意力机制以及 CNN-Transformer 混合模型。

在实证研究中，ViTs 已在图像分类、目标检测和语义分割等任务上取得了最先进（state-of-the-art）的结果，尤其是在大规模数据集上进行预训练并针对下游任务进行微调时表现尤为突出。其高度的灵活性和强大的表征学习能力，持续推动着高效注意力机制、数据高效训练方法以及多模态视觉-语言模型等方向的研究。

instruction: 请翻译以下AI领域的文本。
input: Pretrained language models (PLMs) constitute a foundational paradigm in modern natural language processing by leveraging large-scale unsupervised or self-supervised learning on massive text corpora to acquire generalizable linguistic representations. Typically based on the Transformer architecture, PLMs are trained using objectives such as masked language modeling, causal language modeling, or denoising autoencoding, which enable the model to capture complex syntactic structures, semantic relationships, and contextual dependencies across long sequences. Through pretraining, the model parameters encode rich statistical regularities of natural language, significantly reducing the amount of task-specific labeled data required for downstream applications. Fine-tuning or adaptation techniques—such as full-parameter fine-tuning, parameter-efficient methods (e.g., LoRA, adapters), or prompt-based learning—allow PLMs to be specialized for tasks including text classification, question answering, machine translation, and information retrieval. Recent advances emphasize scaling laws, demonstrating predictable performance improvements with increased model size, data volume, and computational budget. Additionally, instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) have been introduced to align pretrained models with human preferences and improve controllability and safety. Despite their effectiveness, PLMs present challenges related to computational cost, energy consumption, data bias, and interpretability, motivating ongoing research into efficient architectures, sparse modeling, and responsible AI practices.
output: 预训练语言模型（Pretrained Language Models，PLMs）构成了现代自然语言处理中的一种基础性范式，其通过在大规模文本语料上进行无监督或自监督学习，获取具有良好泛化能力的语言表示。PLMs 通常基于 Transformer 架构，并采用掩码语言建模（masked language modeling）、因果语言建模（causal language modeling）或去噪自编码（denoising autoencoding）等训练目标，使模型能够捕获复杂的句法结构、语义关系以及长序列中的上下文依赖。通过预训练，模型参数编码了自然语言中丰富的统计规律，从而显著减少下游应用中对任务特定标注数据的需求。微调或适配技术——如全参数微调、参数高效方法（例如 LoRA、adapter）以及基于提示（prompt-based）的学习——使 PLMs 能够针对文本分类、问答、机器翻译和信息检索等任务进行专门化。近年来的研究进展强调了规模定律（scaling laws），表明随着模型规模、数据量和计算预算的增加，模型性能会呈现可预测的提升。此外，引入指令微调（instruction tuning）和基于人类反馈的强化学习（reinforcement learning from human feedback，RLHF），旨在使预训练模型更好地与人类偏好对齐，并提升其可控性与安全性。尽管 PLMs 表现出显著的有效性，但其在计算成本、能源消耗、数据偏置以及可解释性方面仍面临挑战，这促使学术界持续探索高效架构、稀疏建模以及负责任的人工智能实践。

instruction: Extract the main ideas from the following text.
input:
Large-scale pretrained models have become the dominant paradigm in natural language processing, computer vision, and multimodal learning. While these models demonstrate strong generalization capabilities, adapting them to downstream tasks traditionally relies on full fine-tuning, which updates all model parameters. This approach poses significant challenges: it is computationally expensive, memory-intensive, and often impractical for deployment in resource-constrained environments. Moreover, maintaining separate fully fine-tuned copies of large models for multiple tasks leads to substantial storage and operational overhead. These issues motivate the development of Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) techniques, which aim to achieve competitive task performance while updating only a small subset of model parameters.

PEFT methods are designed around the core idea that a pretrained model already contains rich, general-purpose representations, and task-specific adaptation can be achieved through lightweight modifications. One prominent category of PEFT methods is additive adaptation, exemplified by Adapter-based approaches. Adapters introduce small bottleneck neural modules into each transformer layer, typically after the attention or feed-forward sublayers. During fine-tuning, only the adapter parameters are updated, while the original model weights remain frozen. This significantly reduces the number of trainable parameters and enables modular reuse across tasks.

Another influential class of PEFT methods focuses on low-rank parameterization. Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) approximates weight updates by decomposing them into low-rank matrices that are injected into existing linear transformations, particularly within attention projections. By constraining updates to a low-dimensional subspace, LoRA achieves high parameter efficiency while preserving expressiveness. Related techniques include prefix tuning and prompt tuning, which optimize continuous prompt vectors or prefix tokens prepended to the input sequence, effectively steering model behavior without modifying internal weights.

From an optimization and systems perspective, PEFT offers multiple advantages. Training becomes faster and more memory-efficient, enabling fine-tuning on consumer-grade GPUs or even edge devices. Since the base model is frozen, catastrophic forgetting is reduced, and multiple task-specific adaptations can share a single backbone model. Furthermore, PEFT methods are well-suited for federated learning and continual learning scenarios, where communication and storage efficiency are critical.

Empirical results across benchmarks in language understanding, generation, and vision tasks demonstrate that PEFT methods can achieve performance comparable to full fine-tuning, often within a small margin, while updating less than 1–5% of the total parameters. In some low-resource or domain-adaptation settings, PEFT even exhibits better generalization due to its implicit regularization effect. As model sizes continue to scale, PEFT is increasingly viewed not as an optional optimization, but as a fundamental technique for sustainable and practical model adaptation.
output: 参数高效微调（PEFT）通过仅更新少量参数实现大模型下游适配，降低计算与存储成本。典型方法包括Adapter、LoRA、Prompt/Prefix Tuning，在冻结主干模型的同时保持接近全量微调的性能，适合资源受限与多任务场景。

instruction: 用简洁的语言概括下文的主要观点。

随着深度学习、科学计算和图形渲染等应用规模的迅速增长，传统CPU受限于指令级并行度和功耗墙，已难以满足高吞吐计算需求。GPU凭借大规模并行架构和高内存带宽，成为数据并行型任务的核心计算平台，其并行计算模型逐渐成为高性能计算的重要基础。

GPU并行计算通常采用SIMT模型，将大量轻量级线程组织为warp并在同一指令流下执行。以CUDA和OpenCL为代表的编程框架，通过线程层次结构、共享内存和流式多处理器等机制，帮助开发者显式管理并行度与存储层次。性能优化的关键在于提高线程占用率、减少分支发散、隐藏内存访问延迟，并充分利用寄存器、共享内存与全局内存之间的带宽差异。

在实际应用中，GPU并行计算可在矩阵运算、卷积计算和蒙特卡洛模拟等场景下获得数量级的性能提升。通过合理的算法重构与内存访问优化，GPU不仅显著提高了计算效率，也在能效比方面优于CPU方案，已成为现代异构计算体系中的核心组成部分。
output: GPU凭借大规模并行与高带宽弥补CPU瓶颈，采用SIMT模型。CUDA/OpenCL通过线程层次和共享内存管理并行与存储，优化占用率与访存，在矩阵、卷积等任务中实现高性能与高能效。

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
Multimodal learning addresses the problem of modeling and reasoning over data that arise from heterogeneous sources such as text, images, audio, video, and sensor signals. In real-world environments, information is rarely unimodal; human perception and communication naturally integrate multiple modalities. Traditional machine learning pipelines, however, have often treated each modality in isolation, leading to incomplete representations and limited generalization. The core motivation of multimodal learning is to exploit complementary and redundant information across modalities in order to improve robustness, accuracy, and semantic understanding in downstream tasks such as classification, retrieval, generation, and decision making.

At the methodological level, multimodal learning typically involves three key challenges: representation, alignment, and fusion. Representation learning aims to encode each modality into a latent space that preserves modality-specific structure while enabling cross-modal interaction. Deep neural networks tailored to different data types, such as convolutional neural networks for vision, recurrent or transformer-based architectures for language, and spectrogram-based models for audio, are commonly used as modality-specific encoders. Alignment focuses on establishing correspondences between modalities, either at the instance level (e.g., image–caption pairs) or at finer temporal or semantic granularity. Techniques such as contrastive learning, canonical correlation analysis, and cross-modal matching losses are widely adopted to enforce shared semantics across embeddings.

Fusion strategies determine how multimodal information is combined. Early fusion concatenates or jointly embeds raw or low-level features, enabling rich interactions but often suffering from high dimensionality and noise. Late fusion aggregates decisions or predictions from unimodal models, offering modularity at the cost of weaker cross-modal reasoning. Hybrid or intermediate fusion, which integrates modalities at multiple network layers, has emerged as a practical compromise. Recently, attention-based models, especially multimodal transformers, have become dominant due to their ability to perform dynamic, context-dependent fusion via self-attention and cross-attention mechanisms. These architectures allow models to selectively attend to relevant signals across modalities, improving scalability and interpretability.

Empirically, multimodal learning has demonstrated significant performance gains over unimodal baselines across a wide range of benchmarks, including visual question answering, audiovisual speech recognition, image-text retrieval, and multimodal machine translation. Beyond accuracy improvements, multimodal models tend to be more robust to missing or noisy inputs and exhibit better generalization under distribution shifts. Nonetheless, challenges remain, such as data imbalance between modalities, synchronization errors, and the high computational cost of training large-scale multimodal systems.

In conclusion, multimodal learning provides a principled framework for integrating heterogeneous data sources and has become a foundational paradigm in modern artificial intelligence. Continued advances in representation alignment, efficient fusion mechanisms, and large-scale pretraining are likely to further enhance its applicability in real-world systems, from human–computer interaction to autonomous agents.
output: 多模态学习通过联合建模文本、图像、音频等异构数据，利用互补冗余信息提升鲁棒性与语义理解。核心在表示学习、跨模态对齐与信息融合，常用对比学习与注意力/多模态Transformer。虽显著提升多任务性能，但仍面临数据不平衡与计算成本挑战。

input: 近年来，优化器算法改进主要围绕自适应学习率、动量机制与二阶信息近似展开。以Adam、AdamW为代表的方法通过一阶与二阶矩估计及偏置校正，实现参数尺度自适应与稳定收敛；引入权重衰减解耦可改善泛化。进一步的研究结合预条件、曲率近似与方差约减，在大规模与稀疏梯度场景下降低噪声、提升收敛速率与鲁棒性，同时兼顾计算与内存开销，为深度模型训练提供更优折中。
output: In recent years, improvements to optimization algorithms have mainly focused on adaptive learning rates, momentum mechanisms, and approximations of second-order information. Methods represented by Adam and AdamW achieve parameter-wise scale adaptivity and stable convergence through first- and second-moment estimation with bias correction; the decoupling of weight decay further improves generalization. Subsequent research integrates preconditioning, curvature approximation, and variance reduction to reduce noise and enhance convergence speed and robustness in large-scale and sparse-gradient scenarios, while balancing computational and memory overhead, thereby providing a more favorable trade-off for deep model training.

instruction: 阅读下文，用一句话概括其主要贡献。
input:
随着深度学习模型规模和数据量持续增长，单机训练在计算、内存和训练时间上的瓶颈日益突出，分布式训练框架成为支撑大模型训练的关键基础设施。其核心问题在于如何在多节点、多加速器环境下高效划分计算与通信，同时保证数值一致性、可扩展性与稳定性。

主流方案通常以数据并行、模型并行和流水线并行为基本范式。数据并行通过梯度同步实现横向扩展，常采用All-Reduce算法并依赖NCCL等高性能通信库；模型并行和张量并行将参数切分到不同设备，缓解显存压力；流水线并行通过微批次调度提升设备利用率。在系统层面，框架往往提供自动并行策略、参数服务器或去中心化通信、混合精度训练、检查点与容错机制，并与Kubernetes等调度系统集成。以PyTorch DDP、Horovod和DeepSpeed为代表的实现，进一步在易用性与性能之间取得平衡。

实践表明，成熟的分布式训练框架能够在保证收敛一致性的前提下实现近线性加速，显著降低大模型训练成本。但其性能仍受网络带宽、负载不均和并行策略选择影响，未来需要在自适应并行、弹性训练和系统—算法协同优化方面持续演进。
output: 分布式训练通过多种并行范式实现大模型高效可扩展训练，但仍受系统瓶颈制约。

instruction: 翻译成英文：
input: 过拟合与欠拟合是监督学习中模型泛化能力不足的两种典型形态。欠拟合通常源于模型容量过低或特征表达不足，表现为训练误差与测试误差均较高，体现高偏差问题；过拟合则因模型复杂度过高、参数过多或样本噪声干扰，导致训练误差很低而测试误差显著上升，体现高方差特性。二者可通过偏差—方差权衡进行统一分析。实践中，可借助交叉验证评估泛化性能，并通过正则化、特征选择、数据增广、早停及集成学习等手段，平衡模型复杂度与数据规模，从而提升泛化能力。
output: Overfitting and underfitting are two typical manifestations of insufficient generalization capability in supervised learning models. Underfitting usually arises from insufficient model capacity or inadequate feature representation, and is characterized by high training error and high test error, reflecting a high-bias problem. Overfitting, in contrast, results from excessive model complexity, an excessive number of parameters, or interference from noisy samples, leading to very low training error but a significant increase in test error, reflecting high-variance characteristics. Both phenomena can be analyzed within the unified framework of the bias–variance trade-off. In practice, generalization performance can be evaluated using cross-validation, and improved by balancing model complexity and data scale through techniques such as regularization, feature selection, data augmentation, early stopping, and ensemble learning.

instruction: 请总结以下技术文档的核心内容。
input:
强化学习与人类反馈（RLHF）主要用于解决大规模预训练模型在对齐性与可控性上的不足。传统基于最大似然的训练目标难以显式刻画人类偏好，导致模型在安全性、事实性和指令遵循方面存在偏差。随着模型规模扩大，这一问题被进一步放大，亟需引入人类监督信号进行校正。

RLHF通常分为三个阶段：首先通过监督微调（SFT）使策略模型具备基本任务能力；其次收集人类对模型输出的偏好数据，训练奖励模型（Reward Model）以近似人类评价函数；最后利用强化学习算法（如PPO）在奖励模型约束下优化策略，并通过KL正则项限制策略偏移，防止灾难性偏离原分布。该流程本质上是在不完全可观测的偏好空间中进行近似最优策略搜索。

实践表明，RLHF能够显著提升模型在指令对齐、交互质量和安全性方面的表现，是当前通用大模型对齐的关键技术路径。然而，其效果高度依赖高质量偏好数据，且存在奖励模型偏置、训练不稳定和成本高昂等问题。未来研究正探索RLAIF、直接偏好优化（DPO）等替代方案，以降低复杂度并提升可扩展性。
output: RLHF通过引入人类偏好弥补预训练模型对齐不足，流程包括SFT、奖励模型训练与PPO优化并以KL约束稳定策略。其显著提升指令对齐与安全性，但依赖高质量数据、成本高且易受奖励偏置影响，促使RLAIF与DPO等替代方法发展。

instruction: 将下文翻译成中文，注意保留技术术语。
input: Model compression and quantization techniques are critical for deploying deep neural networks in resource-constrained environments without significantly sacrificing accuracy. Model compression encompasses a family of methods such as parameter pruning, low-rank factorization, weight sharing, and knowledge distillation, which aim to reduce model size and computational complexity by exploiting redundancy in overparameterized networks. Among these, structured and unstructured pruning remove redundant weights or entire channels based on magnitude or sensitivity criteria, while low-rank decomposition approximates dense weight matrices using factorized representations. Quantization further reduces memory footprint and inference latency by representing weights and activations with low-precision numerical formats, such as INT8 or INT4, instead of 32-bit floating-point values. Common approaches include post-training quantization (PTQ), which relies on calibration datasets and techniques such as KL-divergence minimization, and quantization-aware training (QAT), which simulates quantization effects during training to improve accuracy retention. Advanced schemes leverage per-channel and non-uniform quantization, mixed-precision strategies, and learned step sizes to better align numerical precision with layer-wise sensitivity. When co-designed with modern hardware accelerators, these techniques significantly reduce memory bandwidth requirements and energy consumption, enabling efficient inference on edge devices while maintaining robust performance across diverse deployment scenarios.
output: 模型压缩与量化技术是在不显著牺牲精度的前提下，将深度神经网络部署到资源受限环境中的关键手段。模型压缩涵盖了一系列方法，包括参数剪枝、低秩分解、权重共享以及知识蒸馏等，其目标是通过挖掘过参数化网络中的冗余性，降低模型规模和计算复杂度。其中，结构化剪枝与非结构化剪枝依据权值幅度或敏感性准则移除冗余权重或整个通道，而低秩分解则通过因式分解表示来近似稠密权重矩阵。量化进一步通过使用低精度数值格式（如 INT8 或 INT4）替代 32 位浮点数来表示权重和激活，从而降低内存占用并减少推理延迟。常见方法包括训练后量化（Post-Training Quantization，PTQ），其依赖校准数据集并结合 KL 散度最小化等技术，以及量化感知训练（Quantization-Aware Training，QAT），通过在训练过程中模拟量化效应以提升精度保持能力。更先进的方案还引入了按通道量化和非均匀量化、混合精度策略以及可学习步长，以更好地将数值精度与各层的敏感性相匹配。当与现代硬件加速器进行协同设计时，这些技术能够显著降低内存带宽需求和能耗，使得在边缘设备上实现高效推理成为可能，同时在多样化的部署场景中保持稳健的性能表现。

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
Reinforcement Learning with Human Feedback (RLHF) has emerged as a critical paradigm for aligning machine learning models, particularly large language models (LLMs), with human preferences and values. Traditional supervised learning relies on static datasets with predefined labels, which often fail to capture nuanced human judgments such as helpfulness, harmlessness, or stylistic quality. Pure reinforcement learning (RL), while powerful in sequential decision-making, typically requires a well-defined reward function, which is difficult to specify for complex, subjective tasks. RLHF addresses this gap by incorporating human evaluations directly into the training loop, enabling models to optimize behaviors that are difficult to formalize algorithmically.

The standard RLHF pipeline consists of three main stages. First, a base model is pretrained using large-scale self-supervised learning, usually via maximum likelihood estimation on massive text corpora. This stage provides general linguistic and world knowledge but does not guarantee alignment with human expectations. Second, a reward model is trained using human feedback. Human annotators are presented with multiple model-generated outputs for the same prompt and asked to rank them according to preference criteria. These pairwise or listwise rankings are then used to train a reward model, often implemented as a neural network that predicts a scalar reward reflecting human preference. This learned reward function serves as a proxy for otherwise intractable human values.

In the third stage, the base model is fine-tuned using reinforcement learning, most commonly with policy optimization algorithms such as Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). The language model is treated as a stochastic policy over tokens, and the reward model provides feedback on generated sequences. To ensure training stability and prevent catastrophic drift from the pretrained distribution, a Kullback–Leibler (KL) divergence penalty is typically added to the objective, constraining the updated policy to remain close to the original model. This balance between exploration and regularization is crucial for maintaining fluency while improving alignment.

Empirically, RLHF has been shown to significantly improve subjective quality metrics, including perceived usefulness, coherence, and safety. Models trained with RLHF are better at following instructions, refusing harmful requests, and adapting to human communication norms. However, the approach also introduces new challenges. Human feedback is expensive, potentially biased, and difficult to scale. Reward models can be exploited by the policy, leading to reward hacking, and alignment achieved through RLHF may reflect annotator preferences rather than universally valid values. Despite these limitations, RLHF currently represents one of the most effective and practical methods for aligning advanced AI systems with human intent, and it continues to be an active area of research in both academia and industry.
output: RLHF通过引入人类反馈训练奖励模型并结合强化学习微调，实现大模型与人类偏好和价值的有效对齐。

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
随着大规模语言模型（LLM）在代码生成、信息检索与决策支持中的广泛应用，如何稳定、可控地引导模型输出成为核心问题。Prompt Engineering 指通过设计高质量提示词，将任务目标、上下文信息与约束条件显式注入模型，以缓解模型在特定场景下的泛化不足与幻觉风险。

在方法层面，常见策略包括角色设定与指令分离、结构化提示模板、Few-shot 示例学习以及分步推理提示。角色设定用于限定语域与专业边界，减少语义漂移；模板化提示通过明确输入输出格式提升结果的可解析性与一致性；Few-shot 示例通过示例分布对齐任务空间，增强模型对隐含规则的捕捉能力；分步推理提示将复杂问题拆解为多个子任务，从而降低推理复杂度。进一步结合检索增强生成（RAG）、函数调用与外部工具，可将实时知识与确定性计算纳入生成流程，提高可靠性与可验证性。

从效果上看，Prompt Engineering 在无需参数微调的前提下，能够显著提升模型的准确率、稳定性与可复现性，并降低系统迭代成本。通过离线评测、A/B 测试与自动化指标持续优化提示，可逐步沉淀可复用的提示资产。总体而言，Prompt Engineering 是连接通用模型能力与具体业务需求的重要工程手段。
output: 提示工程通过设计高质量提示，在无需微调下显著提升大模型输出的可控性与可靠性。

instruction: Translate the following CS paper abstract into Chinese.
input: Image generation models aim to learn a high-dimensional mapping from a latent representation or noise distribution to the space of natural images, capturing complex visual semantics, textures, and spatial dependencies. Early approaches such as Variational Autoencoders (VAEs) formalized this task via probabilistic latent variable models, optimizing an evidence lower bound (ELBO) to balance reconstruction fidelity and latent regularization, albeit often at the cost of blurry outputs due to Gaussian assumptions. Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) later reframed image synthesis as a minimax game between a generator and a discriminator, achieving sharp and realistic samples but suffering from training instability, mode collapse, and sensitivity to hyperparameters. More recently, diffusion-based models have emerged as a dominant paradigm by learning to iteratively denoise samples from a known noise process, effectively approximating the data distribution through a sequence of conditional transitions. These models exhibit superior sample diversity, stable training dynamics, and strong likelihood-based foundations, especially when implemented in a latent space to improve computational efficiency. Conditioning mechanisms, such as classifier-free guidance, cross-attention, and multimodal encoders, enable controllable generation from text, layouts, or other modalities. Transformer architectures further enhance scalability and global coherence by modeling long-range dependencies. Evaluation typically relies on metrics like Fréchet Inception Distance (FID), Inception Score (IS), and human perceptual studies, though aligning these metrics with subjective visual quality remains an open research challenge.
output: 图像生成模型旨在学习从潜在表示或噪声分布到自然图像空间的高维映射，从而捕捉复杂的视觉语义、纹理以及空间依赖关系。早期方法如变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoders，VAEs）通过概率潜变量模型对这一任务进行形式化，采用证据下界（Evidence Lower Bound，ELBO）进行优化，在重建保真度与潜空间正则化之间取得平衡，但由于高斯分布假设的限制，往往导致生成结果模糊。随后，生成对抗网络（Generative Adversarial Networks，GANs）将图像合成重新表述为生成器与判别器之间的极小极大博弈，能够生成清晰且逼真的样本，但也面临训练不稳定、模式崩塌以及对超参数高度敏感等问题。近年来，基于扩散的模型逐渐成为主流范式，其通过学习从已知噪声过程出发的逐步去噪过程，有效地以一系列条件转移近似数据分布。这类模型在样本多样性、训练稳定性以及基于似然的理论基础方面表现优越，尤其是在潜空间中实现时，可显著提升计算效率。条件化机制（如 classifier-free guidance、cross-attention 以及多模态编码器）使得模型能够根据文本、布局或其他模态实现可控生成。Transformer 架构通过建模长程依赖关系，进一步提升了模型的可扩展性和全局一致性。模型评估通常依赖于 Fréchet Inception Distance（FID）、Inception Score（IS）以及人类感知评测等指标，但如何使这些指标与主观视觉质量更好地对齐，仍然是一个有待解决的研究挑战。

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
Model fine-tuning has emerged as a core technique for adapting large pre-trained models to specific downstream tasks, particularly in the context of deep learning and large-scale neural networks. Modern foundation models, such as large language models or vision transformers, are typically trained on massive, generic datasets using self-supervised or weakly supervised objectives. While these models learn broad and transferable representations, their out-of-the-box performance on domain-specific or task-specific problems is often suboptimal. Fine-tuning addresses this gap by updating model parameters using task-relevant labeled data, enabling specialization while leveraging prior knowledge embedded in the pre-trained weights.

From a methodological perspective, fine-tuning can be implemented in several forms depending on data availability, computational constraints, and task requirements. The most straightforward approach is full-parameter fine-tuning, where all model weights are updated via gradient-based optimization on the target dataset. This method generally yields strong performance but is computationally expensive and prone to overfitting, especially when labeled data is scarce. To mitigate these issues, partial fine-tuning strategies are widely adopted. These include freezing lower layers and updating only higher-level layers, which assumes that lower layers capture general features while upper layers encode task-specific semantics.

More recently, parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) techniques have gained significant attention. Methods such as adapter layers, prefix tuning, prompt tuning, and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) introduce a small number of trainable parameters while keeping the original model weights fixed. For example, LoRA decomposes weight updates into low-rank matrices, substantially reducing memory footprint and training cost without significant loss in performance. These approaches are particularly valuable for deploying large models in resource-constrained environments or for maintaining multiple task-specific variants of a single base model.

The effectiveness of fine-tuning is influenced by several practical factors, including learning rate scheduling, regularization strategies, and data quality. Catastrophic forgetting, where the model loses general knowledge acquired during pre-training, remains a key challenge. Techniques such as smaller learning rates, gradual unfreezing, and mixed-task training are commonly used to preserve generalization. Additionally, domain mismatch between pre-training and fine-tuning data can significantly affect convergence behavior and final performance, making careful dataset curation and evaluation essential.

Empirical results across natural language processing, computer vision, and speech recognition consistently demonstrate that fine-tuning substantially improves task-specific accuracy, robustness, and sample efficiency compared to training from scratch. In conclusion, model fine-tuning represents a critical bridge between general-purpose pre-trained models and real-world applications. Ongoing research continues to focus on making fine-tuning more efficient, stable, and scalable, ensuring its central role in the practical deployment of advanced AI systems.
output: 模型微调通过利用少量任务数据更新预训练模型，使其适配特定任务。方法包括全参数与部分微调，以及LoRA、Adapter等参数高效微调，降低计算与存储成本。效果受学习率、数据质量和灾难性遗忘影响，是大模型落地的关键技术。

instruction: 将以下中文技术文档翻译成英文。
input: 模型监控与维护是MLOps体系的核心环节，旨在保障模型在生产环境中的稳定性与有效性。通过对数据分布漂移、概念漂移及特征完整性的持续监测，结合精度、召回率、AUC、推理时延与资源消耗等指标的在线评估，可及时识别性能退化风险。配合日志采集、系统可观测性与告警机制，实施A/B测试、灰度发布与自动回滚，并基于反馈闭环开展再训练、版本治理与合规审计，从而实现模型全生命周期的可控演进。
output: Model monitoring and maintenance constitute the core components of an MLOps framework, aiming to ensure the stability and effectiveness of models in production environments. By continuously monitoring data distribution drift, concept drift, and feature integrity, and by conducting online evaluations of metrics such as accuracy, recall, AUC, inference latency, and resource consumption, potential performance degradation risks can be identified in a timely manner. Combined with log collection, system observability, and alerting mechanisms, practices such as A/B testing, canary deployment, and automated rollback are implemented, and retraining, version governance, and compliance auditing are carried out based on a feedback loop, thereby enabling controlled evolution across the entire model lifecycle.

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
Prompt engineering has emerged as a critical discipline in the effective use of large language models (LLMs), addressing the gap between general-purpose pretrained models and domain-specific task requirements. While modern LLMs demonstrate strong zero-shot and few-shot capabilities, their outputs remain highly sensitive to input formulation. This sensitivity introduces challenges related to reliability, controllability, and alignment with user intent, particularly in production environments where correctness, consistency, and safety are paramount. Prompt engineering seeks to systematically design, optimize, and evaluate prompts to elicit desired model behaviors without modifying model parameters.

At its core, prompt engineering leverages the in-context learning paradigm, where task instructions, constraints, and examples are embedded directly into the input sequence. Common techniques include zero-shot prompting with explicit task descriptions, few-shot prompting using curated input–output exemplars, and role-based prompting that conditions the model on an assumed persona or expertise. More advanced methods incorporate structured prompts, such as templates with delimiters, schemas, or pseudo-code, to reduce ambiguity and improve output determinism. Constraint specification—covering format, tone, length, and permissible operations—plays a crucial role in narrowing the model’s solution space and mitigating hallucinations.

Recent approaches extend beyond static prompt design. Chain-of-thought prompting, when used appropriately, encourages intermediate reasoning to improve performance on multi-step tasks, while self-consistency sampling aggregates multiple model outputs to enhance robustness. Retrieval-augmented prompting integrates external knowledge sources, enabling the model to ground responses in up-to-date or domain-specific data. Additionally, tool-augmented prompts allow LLMs to interact with external APIs, databases, or symbolic solvers, effectively transforming the prompt into an orchestration layer for hybrid AI systems.

The effectiveness of prompt engineering is typically evaluated along multiple dimensions, including task accuracy, response coherence, latency, and cost efficiency. In enterprise settings, prompts are often treated as versioned artifacts, subject to A/B testing and regression analysis. Quantitative metrics may be complemented by human-in-the-loop evaluation to assess qualitative factors such as factuality and alignment with business rules. Importantly, prompt engineering also contributes to AI safety by embedding guardrails, refusal conditions, and content filters directly into the model’s operating context.

In conclusion, prompt engineering represents a pragmatic and powerful interface between human intent and foundation models. As LLMs continue to scale, well-engineered prompts can deliver significant performance gains without the expense of fine-tuning, while also improving transparency and control. Future research is likely to focus on automated prompt optimization, prompt robustness under distribution shift, and the integration of prompting strategies with model-level alignment techniques.
output: 提示工程通过系统化设计与评估提示，引导大模型在不微调参数下满足特定任务需求。其核心技术包括零/少样本、结构化与约束提示、思维链、检索与工具增强，并通过版本化与评测提升可靠性、安全性与可控性。

instruction: 中文翻译：
input: Text generation technology refers to a class of natural language processing (NLP) methods that automatically produce coherent and contextually appropriate text based on given inputs, constraints, or learned patterns from large-scale data. Modern text generation systems are predominantly built on deep learning architectures, particularly Transformer-based models, which leverage self-attention mechanisms to capture long-range dependencies and complex semantic relationships within sequences. These models are typically trained using unsupervised or self-supervised learning objectives, such as next-token prediction or masked language modeling, on massive text corpora. Key components of text generation include tokenization strategies (e.g., subword or byte-pair encoding), probabilistic decoding algorithms (such as greedy decoding, beam search, top-k sampling, and nucleus sampling), and fine-tuning techniques that adapt pretrained models to domain-specific tasks. Advanced approaches incorporate reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) to align generated outputs with human preferences and safety constraints. Evaluation of text generation systems remains challenging and often combines automatic metrics (e.g., perplexity, BLEU, ROUGE) with human judgment to assess fluency, coherence, factuality, and relevance. As text generation technology continues to evolve, ongoing research focuses on improving controllability, reducing hallucinations, enhancing interpretability, and ensuring ethical and responsible deployment in real-world applications.
output: 文本生成技术是指一类自然语言处理（NLP）方法，其目标是在给定输入、约束条件或从大规模数据中学习到的模式基础上，自动生成连贯且符合上下文的文本。现代文本生成系统主要构建于深度学习架构之上，尤其是基于 Transformer 的模型，这类模型利用自注意力（self-attention）机制来捕获序列中的长程依赖关系和复杂语义关联。这些模型通常通过无监督或自监督学习目标进行训练，例如下一个词元预测（next-token prediction）或掩码语言建模（masked language modeling），并依托海量文本语料。文本生成的关键组成部分包括标记化（tokenization）策略（如子词或字节对编码，byte-pair encoding，BPE）、概率解码算法（如贪婪解码、束搜索、Top-k 采样和核采样（nucleus sampling，亦称 Top-p 采样）），以及将预训练模型适配到特定领域任务的微调（fine-tuning）技术。更先进的方法引入了人类反馈强化学习（reinforcement learning from human feedback，RLHF），以使生成结果更好地符合人类偏好和安全约束。文本生成系统的评估仍然具有挑战性，通常需要结合自动化指标（如困惑度、BLEU、ROUGE）与人工评判，从流畅性、连贯性、事实准确性和相关性等方面进行综合评估。随着文本生成技术的持续演进，当前研究重点正集中在提升可控性、减少“幻觉”现象、增强可解释性，以及确保在实际应用中的伦理性与负责任部署。

instruction: 将下文译为英文，注意专业术语的准确性。
input: 梯度裁剪（Gradient Clipping）是一种用于缓解深度神经网络训练过程中梯度爆炸问题的优化技术。其核心思想是在反向传播阶段对梯度幅值施加约束，常见策略包括基于全局L2范数的裁剪与逐参数裁剪：当梯度范数超过预设阈值时，按比例缩放梯度以保持方向不变。该方法在RNN、Transformer等长序列建模任务中尤为有效，能够显著提升数值稳定性与训练收敛性，并可无缝集成于SGD、Adam等主流优化器。然而，裁剪阈值的设定需在收敛速度与模型表达能力之间进行权衡，过度裁剪可能抑制有效梯度，导致欠拟合。
output: Gradient clipping is an optimization technique used to mitigate the exploding gradient problem during the training of deep neural networks. Its core idea is to impose constraints on gradient magnitudes during the backpropagation phase. Common strategies include global L2-norm-based clipping and per-parameter clipping: when the gradient norm exceeds a predefined threshold, the gradients are scaled proportionally to preserve their direction. This method is particularly effective in long-sequence modeling tasks such as RNNs and Transformers, where it can significantly improve numerical stability and training convergence, and it can be seamlessly integrated into mainstream optimizers such as SGD and Adam. However, the choice of the clipping threshold requires a trade-off between convergence speed and model expressiveness, as excessive clipping may suppress useful gradients and lead to underfitting.

instruction: 将以下中文技术文档翻译成英文。
input: 机器翻译方法经历了从基于规则、统计到神经模型的演进。早期基于规则的翻译依赖人工构建的双语词典与句法规则，覆盖性与可扩展性受限。统计机器翻译通过词对齐、短语抽取与概率模型进行译文搜索，典型采用噪声信道模型与对数线性框架。当前主流的神经机器翻译采用编码器—解码器架构，引入注意力机制与Transformer，实现端到端建模；通过大规模并行语料、子词分解、预训练与微调提升泛化能力。解码阶段常用束搜索，评测以BLEU等自动指标为主。
output: Machine translation methods have evolved from rule-based and statistical approaches to neural models. Early rule-based translation relied on manually constructed bilingual dictionaries and syntactic rules, resulting in limited coverage and scalability. Statistical machine translation performs translation search through word alignment, phrase extraction, and probabilistic models, typically adopting the noisy channel model and a log-linear framework. The current mainstream neural machine translation employs an encoder–decoder architecture, introducing attention mechanisms and the Transformer to achieve end-to-end modeling; generalization capability is enhanced through large-scale parallel corpora, subword segmentation, pretraining, and fine-tuning. During decoding, beam search is commonly used, and evaluation primarily relies on automatic metrics such as BLEU.

instruction: 将以下中文技术文档翻译成英文。
input: 参数高效微调（PEFT）是一类旨在降低大规模预训练模型微调成本的关键技术。其核心思想是在冻结主体参数的前提下，仅引入少量可训练参数以适配下游任务。典型方法包括Adapter、LoRA、Prefix Tuning和Prompt Tuning等。PEFT通过低秩分解、子空间映射或软提示学习，显著减少显存占用和计算开销。相比全参数微调，PEFT在多任务与低资源场景下具有更好的可扩展性与部署效率，同时能够保持接近甚至匹敌的性能表现。因此，PEFT已成为大模型时代重要的高效迁移学习范式。
output: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT) refers to a class of key techniques aimed at reducing the cost of fine-tuning large-scale pre-trained models. The core idea is to freeze the main model parameters and introduce only a small number of trainable parameters to adapt the model to downstream tasks. Representative methods include Adapters, LoRA, Prefix Tuning, and Prompt Tuning. Through approaches such as low-rank decomposition, subspace mapping, or soft prompt learning, PEFT significantly reduces memory footprint and computational overhead. Compared with full-parameter fine-tuning, PEFT exhibits better scalability and deployment efficiency in multi-task and low-resource scenarios, while maintaining performance that is close to or even on par with full fine-tuning. Consequently, PEFT has become an important paradigm for efficient transfer learning in the era of large models.

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input:
Modern data-intensive systems rely on robust data pipeline design to transform raw, heterogeneous data into reliable, analytics-ready assets. As organizations ingest data from transactional systems, IoT devices, logs, and third-party APIs at increasing scale and velocity, poorly designed pipelines can become a primary source of latency, data quality issues, and operational risk. The core challenge lies in building pipelines that are scalable, fault-tolerant, and evolvable while maintaining strong guarantees around data consistency, observability, and governance.

A well-designed data pipeline typically decomposes the end-to-end flow into ingestion, processing, storage, and serving layers. At the ingestion stage, pipelines must support both batch and streaming data sources. Technologies such as Apache Kafka, Amazon Kinesis, or cloud-native message queues are commonly used to decouple producers and consumers, enabling back-pressure handling and horizontal scalability. Schema management at this stage is critical; adopting schema registries and enforcing schema evolution rules helps prevent downstream breakages and supports backward and forward compatibility.

The processing layer is responsible for data transformation, enrichment, validation, and aggregation. Distributed data processing frameworks such as Apache Spark, Flink, or Beam provide abstractions for parallel execution, state management, and windowed computations. Design decisions here often involve choosing between batch processing, micro-batching, and true stream processing, each with different trade-offs in latency, throughput, and complexity. Idempotent transformations and exactly-once or at-least-once processing semantics are essential considerations to ensure correctness in the presence of retries and partial failures. Additionally, incorporating data quality checks—such as constraint validation, anomaly detection, and deduplication—helps shift error detection earlier in the pipeline.

Storage and serving layers must be optimized for downstream access patterns. Data lakes built on object storage offer cost-effective, scalable storage for raw and curated datasets, while data warehouses and lakehouse architectures provide optimized query performance through columnar storage, indexing, and metadata management. Partitioning strategies, file formats (e.g., Parquet or ORC), and compaction policies have a significant impact on query efficiency and maintenance overhead. Serving layers may also include feature stores or low-latency databases to support machine learning and real-time applications.

Operational concerns are central to pipeline design. Observability mechanisms—such as structured logging, metrics, and distributed tracing—enable proactive monitoring and faster incident response. Workflow orchestration tools like Apache Airflow or cloud-native schedulers help manage dependencies, retries, and backfills. Infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD practices further improve reproducibility and reduce configuration drift across environments.

In conclusion, effective data pipeline design is not solely about moving data from source to sink, but about engineering a resilient, observable, and adaptable system. By applying modular architectures, well-defined contracts, and strong operational practices, organizations can build pipelines that scale with data growth, support advanced analytics and machine learning, and deliver trustworthy data products over time.
output: 现代数据管道需将多源数据转为可靠资产，核心在于可扩展、容错和可演进。典型架构含采集、处理、存储与服务层，采用Kafka等解耦、Spark/Flink处理、湖仓存储，并通过模式治理、数据质量、可观测性与编排保障一致性与运维可靠。

instruction: 请提取以下论文片段的核心观点，并进行简要总结。
input:
文档摘要生成旨在从长文本中自动提取或生成能够覆盖核心信息的简短表述，是信息检索、知识管理和智能问答系统中的关键技术。随着数字文档规模的指数级增长，人工摘要在效率和一致性方面难以满足需求，促使研究者转向基于自然语言处理的自动化方法。该任务面临的主要挑战包括语义压缩、关键信息选择以及跨句语义一致性的保持。

从技术路线看，文档摘要生成主要分为抽取式和生成式两类。抽取式方法通过特征工程或图模型（如TextRank）在原文中选择代表性句子，具有语义保真度高、实现稳定的优点，但在信息重组能力上存在局限。生成式方法则依赖序列到序列模型，利用编码器—解码器架构和注意力机制对全文进行语义建模，近年来进一步结合Transformer和预训练语言模型，通过微调实现对上下文语义和篇章结构的深度理解。

在实际效果上，现代生成式摘要模型在ROUGE等自动评测指标上显著优于传统方法，并在可读性和信息覆盖率方面表现突出。然而，其输出仍可能存在事实偏差和冗余问题，需要引入约束解码、事实一致性判别和人机协同校正机制。总体而言，文档摘要生成正朝着高准确性、强泛化性和可控生成方向持续演进，在企业知识治理和智能内容生产中具有广阔应用前景。
output: 文档摘要生成利用NLP自动提炼长文本核心信息，分为抽取式和生成式两类。生成式方法基于Transformer和预训练模型，在信息覆盖与可读性上表现更优，但仍需解决事实一致性与冗余问题，应用前景广阔。

instruction: 请提炼以下段落的核心思想。
input:
强化学习与人类反馈（Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback，RLHF）是在大规模模型训练中为解决“目标对齐”问题而提出的重要范式。传统的强化学习依赖明确的奖励函数，但在自然语言生成、对话系统等复杂任务中，目标往往难以形式化描述，导致模型行为与人类期望存在偏差。

RLHF的核心思想是引入人类作为奖励信号的来源，通过人类偏好来间接定义优化目标。典型流程包括三个阶段：首先在监督学习阶段，利用人工标注的数据对基础模型进行预训练；其次，通过让人类对模型输出进行成对比较，训练一个奖励模型（Reward Model），用于近似人类偏好函数；最后，使用强化学习算法（如PPO，Proximal Policy Optimization）在奖励模型的引导下对策略模型进行优化，并通过约束机制防止策略崩塌和分布漂移。

在实践中，RLHF显著提升了模型在安全性、可控性和有用性方面的表现，使其输出更符合人类价值观和使用习惯。然而，该方法也面临成本高、标注主观性强以及奖励模型偏差累积等挑战。总体而言，RLHF已成为对齐大模型行为的关键技术路线，为构建可靠、可信的通用人工智能系统奠定了重要基础。
output: RLHF通过引入人类偏好解决大模型目标对齐：先监督预训练，再以人工比较训练奖励模型，最后用PPO优化策略并约束漂移。该方法提升安全性与可控性，但成本高且存在偏差。

instruction: English translation:
input: 上下文学习（In-Context Learning）是指大语言模型在不进行参数更新的前提下，仅通过提示中的示例与指令即可完成新任务的能力。其本质可视为一种隐式元学习：模型利用注意力机制对上下文进行任务条件化表征，从序列分布中推断映射规则。研究表明，模型规模、预训练分布与提示结构显著影响少样本与零样本性能，但其内在机制、可解释性及对分布外泛化的边界仍是开放问题。
output: In-Context Learning (ICL) refers to the ability of large language models to perform new tasks without updating parameters, relying solely on examples and instructions provided in the prompt. Its essence can be viewed as a form of implicit meta-learning: the model leverages the attention mechanism to produce task-conditioned representations of the context and to infer mapping rules from the sequence distribution. Studies indicate that model scale, pretraining distribution, and prompt structure significantly affect few-shot and zero-shot performance; however, the underlying mechanisms, interpretability, and the limits of out-of-distribution generalization remain open questions.

instruction: Translate the following Chinese text into English.
input: 预训练语言模型（Pretrained Language Models，PLMs）通过在大规模无标注语料上进行自监督学习，获取通用的语义与句法表示。其核心通常基于Transformer架构，依赖自注意力机制建模长程依赖关系，并采用掩码语言模型（MLM）或自回归目标进行参数预训练。预训练阶段结合子词级分词、分布式并行优化与正则化策略，遵循参数规模、数据规模与计算资源的扩展定律以提升性能。在下游任务中，模型通过微调或参数高效适配方法实现迁移学习，显著降低标注成本并增强泛化能力。
output: Pretrained Language Models (PLMs) acquire general semantic and syntactic representations through self-supervised learning on large-scale unlabeled corpora. Their core architectures are typically based on Transformers, which rely on self-attention mechanisms to model long-range dependencies and employ masked language modeling (MLM) or autoregressive objectives for parameter pretraining. The pretraining phase integrates subword-level tokenization, distributed parallel optimization, and regularization strategies, following scaling laws across model parameters, data size, and computational resources to improve performance. In downstream tasks, models achieve transfer learning through fine-tuning or parameter-efficient adaptation methods, significantly reducing annotation costs and enhancing generalization capability.

instruction: Help me translate this technical content to Chinese.
input: Model compression and quantization techniques are critical for deploying deep learning models in resource-constrained environments while preserving acceptable accuracy and performance. Model compression encompasses a range of methods, including parameter pruning, low-rank factorization, knowledge distillation, and weight sharing, all aimed at reducing model size and computational complexity. Pruning removes redundant or less significant parameters based on structured or unstructured criteria, whereas low-rank decomposition approximates dense weight matrices with factorized representations to lower memory and FLOP requirements. Quantization further optimizes models by reducing numerical precision, typically converting 32-bit floating-point weights and activations into lower-bit representations such as INT8, INT4, or even binary formats. Post-training quantization and quantization-aware training are two dominant paradigms, with the latter incorporating quantization effects during training to mitigate accuracy degradation. Advanced techniques such as mixed-precision quantization, dynamic range quantization, and hardware-aware quantization exploit the trade-offs between precision, latency, and energy efficiency on specific accelerators. Collectively, these approaches enable efficient inference on edge devices and large-scale systems, while also introducing challenges related to numerical stability, error propagation, and model robustness that require careful algorithmic and hardware co-design.
output: 模型压缩与量化技术对于在资源受限的环境中部署深度学习模型至关重要，同时需要在可接受的精度和性能之间取得平衡。模型压缩涵盖了一系列方法，包括参数剪枝、低秩分解、知识蒸馏以及权重共享，其共同目标是降低模型规模和计算复杂度。剪枝通过结构化或非结构化的标准移除冗余或不重要的参数；而低秩分解则通过将稠密权重矩阵近似为因子化表示，以减少内存占用和 FLOPs 需求。量化通过降低数值精度进一步优化模型，通常将 32 位浮点权重和激活值转换为更低比特宽度的表示形式，如 INT8、INT4，甚至二值格式。训练后量化（Post-Training Quantization）和量化感知训练（Quantization-Aware Training）是两种主流范式，其中后者在训练过程中显式引入量化效应，以缓解精度下降问题。诸如混合精度量化、动态范围量化以及硬件感知量化等高级技术，能够在特定加速器上权衡精度、延迟与能效之间的关系。总体而言，这些方法使得在边缘设备和大规模系统上实现高效推理成为可能，但同时也引入了数值稳定性、误差传播以及模型鲁棒性等方面的挑战，需要通过精心的算法与硬件协同设计来加以解决。

instruction: 将下文翻译成中文，注意保留技术术语。
input: Zero-shot learning (ZSL) is a machine learning paradigm that addresses the problem of recognizing or reasoning about classes that are absent from the training data by leveraging auxiliary semantic information. Unlike conventional supervised learning, which assumes that all target classes are observed during training, ZSL relies on a shared semantic space to transfer knowledge from seen classes to unseen ones. This semantic space is typically defined using high-level representations such as attribute vectors, textual descriptions, word embeddings, or knowledge graph embeddings. The core technical challenge in ZSL lies in learning a robust mapping between low-level input features (e.g., visual or acoustic features) and the semantic representations, while mitigating issues such as domain shift and hubness. Many ZSL approaches formulate the problem as either a compatibility learning task, where a scoring function measures the alignment between input instances and class semantics, or a generative modeling task, where synthetic features for unseen classes are generated using models such as variational autoencoders or generative adversarial networks. Recent research has also extended ZSL to generalized zero-shot learning (GZSL), where the model must simultaneously handle both seen and unseen classes at inference time, requiring careful calibration to avoid bias toward seen classes. As a result, zero-shot learning has become a foundational technique for building scalable and adaptable intelligent systems in scenarios where labeled data is scarce or expensive to obtain.
output:
零样本学习（Zero-shot Learning，ZSL）是一种机器学习范式，旨在通过利用辅助语义信息来解决对训练数据中未出现类别进行识别或推理的问题。与传统监督学习假设所有目标类别在训练阶段均可观测不同，ZSL 依赖于一个共享的语义空间，将已见类别中的知识迁移到未见类别中。该语义空间通常由高层语义表示来定义，例如属性向量、文本描述、词嵌入（word embeddings）或知识图谱嵌入（knowledge graph embeddings）。

ZSL 的核心技术挑战在于学习低层输入特征（如视觉特征或声学特征）与语义表示之间的稳健映射，同时缓解领域偏移（domain shift）和枢纽性（hubness）等问题。许多 ZSL 方法将该问题建模为两类典型任务之一：一类是兼容性学习（compatibility learning），通过评分函数来衡量输入实例与类别语义之间的一致性；另一类是生成式建模任务，通过变分自编码器（Variational Autoencoders, VAE）或生成对抗网络（Generative Adversarial Networks, GAN）等模型为未见类别生成合成特征。

近年来，研究工作进一步将 ZSL 扩展到广义零样本学习（Generalized Zero-shot Learning, GZSL）场景，在该设置下，模型在推理阶段需要同时处理已见类别和未见类别，这要求对模型进行精细校准，以避免对已见类别产生偏置。因此，零样本学习已成为在标注数据稀缺或获取成本高昂的应用场景中构建可扩展、可适应智能系统的一项基础性技术。

instruction: 阅读下文，用一句话概括其主要贡献。
input: 在深度神经网络训练过程中，随着网络层数加深，参数更新会导致中间层输入分布不断变化，形成所谓的“内部协变量偏移”，从而使训练不稳定、收敛速度变慢，并对参数初始化和学习率选择高度敏感。为缓解这一问题，批归一化（Batch Normalization，BN）被提出并迅速成为主流网络结构中的关键组件。其核心思想是在小批量数据维度上，对每一层的线性变换结果进行标准化处理，即将激活值减去批均值并除以批标准差，从而使其服从近似稳定的分布。随后，通过引入可学习的缩放参数γ和偏移参数β，恢复网络的表达能力，避免过度约束特征分布。在训练阶段，BN利用当前批次的统计量进行归一化；在推理阶段，则使用滑动平均得到的全局统计量以保证输出稳定性。实践表明，批归一化能够显著加快模型收敛速度，提高梯度传播的稳定性，降低对精细初始化和正则化技巧的依赖，并在一定程度上起到正则化效果，从而提升模型的泛化性能。尽管其在小批量或序列建模任务中存在局限，但BN仍是现代卷积神经网络和深度学习系统中的重要基础技术。
output: 批归一化通过规范化层激活并引入可学习参数，稳定训练分布、加速收敛并提升泛化。

instruction: 将下文译为英文，注意专业术语的准确性。
input: 在大规模语言模型中，幻觉问题指模型在缺乏证据时生成看似合理但不真实的内容，其根源包括训练语料噪声、分布外泛化、目标函数偏置与不确定性建模不足。缓解策略通常从模型、数据与推理三层入手：通过检索增强生成（RAG）与知识对齐实现事实性约束；利用不确定性估计、置信度校准与拒答机制降低过度自信；结合指令微调、RLHF、约束解码与自动化验证，提高输出的可验证性与可追溯性。
output: In large language models, the hallucination problem refers to the generation of seemingly plausible but false content in the absence of supporting evidence. Its root causes include noise in training corpora, out-of-distribution generalization, objective function bias, and insufficient uncertainty modeling. Mitigation strategies typically operate across the model, data, and inference layers: imposing factual constraints through retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and knowledge alignment; reducing overconfidence via uncertainty estimation, confidence calibration, and refusal mechanisms; and improving the verifiability and traceability of outputs by combining instruction tuning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), constrained decoding, and automated verification.

instruction: What are the main points of the following content?
input:
在深度神经网络训练中，尤其是使用反向传播和随机梯度下降时，梯度爆炸是常见且严重的问题。该现象在深层网络、循环神经网络以及长序列建模中尤为突出，会导致参数更新幅度过大，损失函数震荡甚至数值溢出，从而使模型无法收敛。

梯度裁剪（Gradient Clipping）是一种有效的稳定训练策略，其核心思想是在参数更新前对梯度进行约束。最常用的方法是基于范数的裁剪，即当梯度向量的L2范数超过预设阈值时，按比例缩放整个梯度向量，使其范数等于阈值。此外，还有基于数值的裁剪方法，对每个梯度分量直接限制在给定区间内。近年来，针对不同参数尺度差异的问题，提出了全局范数裁剪（Global Norm Clipping）和自适应梯度裁剪（Adaptive Gradient Clipping, AGC），以提升裁剪策略的鲁棒性。

从效果上看，梯度裁剪能够显著缓解训练不稳定问题，提高模型在高学习率或复杂结构下的可训练性。它在不改变优化目标的前提下，限制了极端梯度对参数更新的破坏性影响。实践表明，合理设置裁剪阈值可以加快收敛速度，并提升最终模型的泛化性能，因此已成为深度学习训练流程中的标准技术之一。
output: 梯度裁剪通过约束梯度范数抑制梯度爆炸，稳定并提升深度网络训练可收敛性。

instruction: 用简洁的语言概括这篇论文的主要贡献。
input:
understanding the formation of massive stars is crucial to an understanding of the formation of stars in general and of galaxies . 
 many , perhaps most , stars form in clustered environments where massive stars are present ( lada 1992 , williams & mckee 1997 ) . 
 only massive star formation is readily studied at the distances of other galaxies . in particular , the discovery 
 that star formation at substantial redshifts is often heavily obscured by dust ( e.g. , frayer et al . 2000 ; chapman et al . 
 2001 ) indicates that study of the history of star formation in galaxies , hence the major part of galaxy formation , can be related to what we learn about massive star formation in our own and nearby galaxies . 
 here we consider a number of issues surrounding the formation of massive stars , beginning with a comparison to what we know about the formation of low mass stars , proceeding through some systematic studies of early stages of massive star formation , and ending with some speculations about the initial conditions for massive star formation . 
 in the case of low mass stars , a well - established evolutionary paradigm prevails , and a standard model of star formation ( shu et al . 1987 ) provides a detailed target for observational tests . 
 various alternative models have also been proposed and observers are beginning to compare these models to observations . 
 the evolutionary paradigm is based on the class system ( lada & wilking 1984 , lada 1987 ) , originally proceeding from class i ( deeply embedded ) to iii ( revealed star , weak - line t tauri star ) via class ii ( roughly the same as classical t tauri stars ) . 
 the recent advances in submillimeter capability have revealed a self - luminous phase that is still more embedded than class i , and andr , ward - thompson , & barsony ( 1993 ) called this phase class 0 . 
 the initial conditions for low mass star formation appear to be amenable to study in dense regions without any evidence for internal l...
output:
our knowledge of the initial conditions and early stages of high mass star formation is very limited . we will review recent surveys of regions in the early stages of massive star formation using molecular tracers of high density and dust continuum emission and consider the status of evolutionary schemes . 
 comparison to the situation for low mass , relatively isolated star formation will be used to illustrate the outstanding issues in massive star formation . 
 the problem of initial conditions is particularly acute because there is a lack of observational evidence for regions capable of forming massive stars _ before _ 
 star formation actually begins . by analogy with the pre - protostellar cores ( ppcs ) 
 studied for low - mass star formation , one might call such regions pre - proto - cluster cores ( ppclcs ) 
 . we will conclude with some speculation about what such cores might look like and possibilities for their detection .

instruction: 请将以下英文内容译为中文，保持专业术语准确。
input: Image classification networks are a fundamental class of deep learning models designed to assign semantic labels to images by learning hierarchical feature representations from raw pixel data. Modern architectures are predominantly based on convolutional neural networks (CNNs), which exploit local receptive fields, weight sharing, and spatial invariance through convolutional and pooling operations. Early layers typically capture low-level features such as edges and textures, while deeper layers encode high-level semantic concepts. Prominent architectures, including VGGNet, ResNet, DenseNet, and EfficientNet, introduce architectural innovations such as deeper networks, residual connections, dense feature reuse, and compound scaling to improve representational capacity and training stability. Training image classification networks generally involves supervised learning with large-scale labeled datasets, optimized using stochastic gradient descent or its variants, and regularized through techniques such as data augmentation, dropout, and batch normalization. Loss functions like categorical cross-entropy are commonly employed to align predicted class probabilities with ground-truth labels. More recently, transformer-based models and hybrid CNN-transformer architectures have been explored to capture long-range dependencies and global context more effectively. Image classification networks serve as foundational backbones for numerous downstream vision tasks, including object detection, semantic segmentation, and visual recognition, making them a critical component of modern computer vision systems.

instruction: 请对以下内容进行摘要，突出关键信息。
input:
Hallucination refers to the phenomenon where machine learning models, particularly large language models (LLMs), generate outputs that are syntactically fluent but factually incorrect, logically inconsistent, or unsupported by the input context or training data. This issue has become a central challenge in deploying LLMs for high-stakes applications such as healthcare, legal analysis, scientific research, and decision support systems. Hallucinations arise primarily from the probabilistic nature of generative modeling, where the objective is to maximize likelihood rather than factual correctness, as well as from limitations in training data quality, model architecture, and inference strategies.

From a technical perspective, hallucinations can be broadly categorized into intrinsic and extrinsic types. Intrinsic hallucinations involve contradictions or fabrications within the model’s internal reasoning or generated content, even when sufficient context is provided. Extrinsic hallucinations occur when a model introduces unverifiable or false information not grounded in the input or external knowledge sources. Contributing factors include exposure bias during autoregressive decoding, overgeneralization from pretraining data, and the absence of explicit mechanisms for truth verification or uncertainty estimation.

To mitigate hallucinations, researchers have proposed a range of methods spanning data, model, and system levels. At the data level, improving the quality, diversity, and factual consistency of training corpora is essential. Techniques such as data filtering, adversarial data generation, and fact-aware pretraining aim to reduce spurious correlations learned during training. Instruction tuning and reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) further align model outputs with human preferences for factual accuracy and coherence.

At the model and inference level, architectural enhancements and decoding strategies play a critical role. Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) integrates external knowledge bases or search engines, grounding model outputs in verifiable documents and reducing reliance on parametric memory. Confidence-aware decoding, calibration techniques, and constrained generation can limit unsupported claims. Additionally, incorporating uncertainty estimation, such as probabilistic confidence scores or self-consistency checks, allows models to abstain or hedge when information is insufficient.

System-level solutions emphasize post-generation verification and human-in-the-loop workflows. Automated fact-checking modules, symbolic reasoning components, and rule-based validators can detect and correct hallucinated content. In domain-specific deployments, hybrid systems that combine LLMs with structured databases or expert systems have shown improved robustness. Evaluation benchmarks focusing on factuality, faithfulness, and groundedness are also critical for measuring progress beyond surface-level fluency.

In conclusion, hallucination is not a single failure mode but a systemic issue rooted in how generative models are trained and deployed. While no single technique fully eliminates hallucinations, a combination of data curation, model alignment, retrieval grounding, and verification mechanisms can substantially reduce their frequency and impact. Continued research in interpretability, evaluation, and human-AI collaboration is necessary to build more reliable and trustworthy generative systems.

instruction: 请提炼以下段落的核心思想。
input:
In supervised machine learning, model performance is fundamentally constrained by the tension between underfitting and overfitting. Underfitting occurs when a model is too simple to capture the underlying structure of the data, resulting in high training and test error. Overfitting, in contrast, arises when a model fits the training data too closely, including noise and spurious correlations, leading to low training error but poor generalization to unseen data. These phenomena are commonly framed through the bias–variance tradeoff: underfitting is associated with high bias and low variance, whereas overfitting reflects low bias and high variance. Understanding and controlling this tradeoff is central to robust model design.

The root causes of underfitting typically include insufficient model capacity, overly aggressive regularization, inadequate feature representations, or premature convergence during optimization. Linear models applied to highly nonlinear data, shallow decision trees, or neural networks with too few parameters often fail to approximate the target function. Overfitting, on the other hand, is often driven by excessive model complexity relative to the amount of available data, high-dimensional feature spaces, label noise, or data leakage. Deep neural networks with millions of parameters trained on small datasets are particularly susceptible without appropriate safeguards.

A range of methodological strategies has been developed to mitigate these issues. To address underfitting, practitioners may increase model capacity by adding parameters or layers, introduce nonlinear feature transformations, or reduce regularization strength. Improving data quality and feature engineering can also lower bias by exposing informative patterns. Conversely, combating overfitting typically involves constraining model complexity or improving generalization. Common techniques include L1 and L2 regularization, which penalize large weights; dropout, which stochastically disables neurons during training; and early stopping, which halts optimization based on validation performance. Data-centric approaches such as data augmentation and noise injection effectively increase the diversity of training samples, reducing variance. Model-agnostic techniques like cross-validation enable reliable estimation of generalization error and guide hyperparameter selection, while ensemble methods such as bagging and boosting can reduce variance without substantially increasing bias.

Diagnosing overfitting and underfitting relies heavily on empirical analysis. Learning curves that plot training and validation error as a function of dataset size or training iterations provide actionable insights into whether additional data, capacity, or regularization is likely to be beneficial. From a theoretical perspective, concepts such as VC dimension and Rademacher complexity offer bounds on generalization error, linking model capacity to sample complexity, although these bounds are often loose in modern deep learning settings.

In conclusion, overfitting and underfitting are not isolated pathologies but manifestations of the same underlying tradeoff between bias and variance. Effective machine learning practice requires balancing model expressiveness with appropriate inductive biases, guided by both theoretical principles and empirical validation. By systematically adjusting model capacity, regularization, and data strategies, practitioners can achieve models that generalize well and remain robust in real-world deployments.

instruction: 阅读下文，用一句话概括其主要贡献。
input:
命名实体识别（Named Entity Recognition，NER）是自然语言处理中的核心任务之一，目标是从非结构化文本中自动识别并分类具有特定语义的实体，如人名、地名、组织机构、时间与专有名词等。NER作为信息抽取、知识图谱构建、问答系统和搜索引擎的重要基础，其性能直接影响下游应用效果。在真实场景中，实体边界模糊、歧义性强以及领域差异大，使该问题具有较高挑战性。

早期NER方法主要基于规则和统计学习模型，如隐马尔可夫模型（HMM）和条件随机场（CRF），通常将任务建模为序列标注问题，并采用BIO等标注体系。随着深度学习的发展，基于神经网络的方法逐渐成为主流，例如BiLSTM-CRF模型通过双向循环神经网络捕获上下文信息，再利用CRF建模标签间的依赖关系。近年来，Transformer架构及预训练语言模型（如BERT、RoBERTa）通过上下文化表示和自注意力机制显著提升了特征表达能力，结合微调和迁移学习，在多语言、多领域NER任务中取得领先效果。

在评估方面，NER通常采用精确率、召回率和F1值作为指标。实验表明，预训练模型在标准数据集上显著优于传统方法，但在低资源领域、嵌套实体识别及跨领域迁移场景中仍存在不足。总体而言，NER技术正朝着高鲁棒性、低标注成本和强泛化能力方向发展。
output: NER技术已从规则统计方法演进至Transformer预训练模型，性能大幅提升但在低资源和跨领域场景仍面临挑战。
